description: The JSON release describes cultural-event schedules, categories, venues and audience/pricing metadata. Its explicit used relationships in the ILU catalogue link it to transport-context modelling and bike-demand forecasting; this establishes the infrastructure role beyond a generic cultural listing. Native description identifies 2019 events, while the catalogue also lists 2018–2019, so the wider date span is unverified. The JSON includes descriptive HTML and image pointers, but those bodies and media were not opened. Event metadata are context inputs, not measured passenger demand. Coverage is limited to the source-described systems and experiments. The related Zenodo deposit provides descriptive metadata, with open document or data access and licence label cc-by-4.0. Document rights do not establish software rights or access to the underlying observations. Only full descriptive metadata, file inventories and the project metadata catalogue were reviewed; no underlying measurements, code, paper or model archive was opened.
